'''Keith Lockwood''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 1999 Geelong tournament]] on 25 November 1999 with Space deck with Secret Plans, Lateral Damage, IAO, according to Michael Josem's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d126">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-27-geelong-australia-25-november-1999d126/ geelong-australia-25-november-1999], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 27 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-27-geelong-australia-25-november-1999d126/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
